item.title: Melissa now tied for strongest hurricane ever recorded, NHC post-storm analysis finds
item.description: (WGHP) – Four months after Hurricane Melissa devastated western Jamaica, the National Hurricane Center released a tropical cyclone report, upgrading Melissa’s peak sustained wind speeds to 190 mph. Melissa now ties Hurricane Allen (1980) as the strongest hurricane ever recorded in the Atlantic Basin. With a minimum central pressure of 892 mb, Melissa also tied [...]
